node.method: Preloaded sweep: 10 s warmup and 15 s per measured stage. Normal loading: 10 s warmup and 20 s per measured stage. Arrivals: 30 s target-rate warmup and 60 s measurement in fresh worker, service, and driver processes for each offered rate. Each capture uses two reversed process populations on linux, target Node v26.9.0, Node v26.9.0 load drivers, AMD Ryzen 7 8745HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics
node.validation: 72 request errors in scheduled arrivals, including 72 during warmup; zero in concurrency captures. Response identities and accounting validated; RPS counts valid responses only

bun.method: Preloaded sweep: 10 s warmup and 15 s per measured stage. Normal loading: 10 s warmup and 20 s per measured stage. Arrivals: 30 s target-rate warmup and 60 s measurement in fresh worker, service, and driver processes for each offered rate. Each capture uses two reversed process populations on linux, target Bun 1.4.2, Node v26.9.0 load drivers, AMD Ryzen 7 8745HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics
bun.validation: Zero request errors in these captures; response identities and accounting validated
